bile.detail: Grendel is the classic Bile-eater — budgeting Bile around his subsume is the reason most players learn what Bile is. Gauss's subsume cost also includes Bile. Exact costs are shown in the chair UI before you confirm; check them and make sure your Bile meter can cover it.
bile.title: Known Bile-eaters

bile.detail: Bile comes from rare, annoying-to-farm resources (Argon Crystals, Morphics, Cryotic, Nav Coordinates, Orokin Ciphers). Argon Crystals decay after 24 hours, so feed them before they expire. When in doubt, subsume the Bile-cost frames last.
bile.title: Why Bile hurts

bile.detail: Subsuming every Warframe in the game costs over 1,800% Bile total — more than any other secretion. Infusing abilities costs hundreds of percent more. Keep a Bile reserve and rotate which resources you feed (green arrow = 30% efficiency) so Bile never bottoms out.
bile.title: Total Bile appetite

innate.desc: Grants +50% Ability Strength to your NEXT ability cast. Not timed and doesn't scale — it just works, independent of your stats.
innate.name: Empower
innate.note: Rank 0. The S-tier innate: buff one big cast (Wisp buffs, Roar, Eclipse) then play normally.

innate.desc: Increases parkour velocity (sprint, slide, bullet jump) for a duration. Scales with Ability Strength — on fast frames it gets uncontrollable.
innate.name: Infested Mobility
innate.note: Rank 0. Niche: speedrun and capture missions when you have a dead ability slot.

innate.desc: Heals your companion and teleports it to your side.
innate.name: Master's Summons
innate.note: Rank 0. Quality-of-life for pet leveling and long defenses.

innate.desc: Instantly restores your shields to full. 12 second cooldown. Costs scale badly on high-shield frames (e.g. Hildryn).
innate.name: Rebuild Shields
innate.note: Rank 2. Mostly outclassed by shield-gating builds; skip it.

innate.desc: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt. Cheap to cast.
innate.name: Perspicacity
innate.note: Rank 3. The spy-mission cheat code — fly through vaults without playing the minigame.

innate.desc: 75% ammo efficiency for 5 seconds — your guns barely consume ammo while active.
innate.name: Energized Munitions
innate.note: Rank 5. Great on ammo-hungry weapons (Kuva Bramma, Kohm, Trumna).

innate.desc: Stuns an enemy; 75% of the next damage you deal to it explodes around it in an AoE.
innate.name: Marked for Death
innate.note: Rank 6. Niche nuke enabler for big single-target hits.

innate.desc: Hits enemies in a cone, detonating all Bleed and Toxin DoTs on them for their remaining damage instantly.
innate.name: Expedite Suffering
innate.note: Rank 9. Pairs with Slash/Toxin builds for instant burst.

innate.desc: Sacrifice shields to reinforce armor for 25 seconds (100% conversion).
innate.name: Parasitic Armor
innate.note: Rank 11. Shield-tank frames turn overshield into real armor.

innate.desc: Grants immunity to Status effects, 10 charges.
innate.name: Hideous Resistance
innate.note: Rank 12. Anti-Toxin/anti-proc tech for frames without status immunity.

innate.desc: Consume energy to heal yourself and grant matching energy to each ally over 10 seconds.
innate.name: Voracious Metastasis
innate.note: Rank 13. Support tech; energy-hungry squads love it.

innate.desc: Emits a pulse that adds stacks to status effects on enemies — Bleed, Heat and Toxin get duplicated with fresh timers instead.
innate.name: Sickening Pulse

innate.desc: Sends out a Void Spark that homes in on the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or fragment within 200m.
innate.name: Golden Instinct
innate.note: Rank 15. Loot radar for completionists and syndicate medallion hunts.

invigoration.detail: Buy the Helminth Invigoration Segment blueprint from Son in the Necralisk. It becomes usable once your Helminth reaches Metamorphosis rank 5.
invigoration.title: How to unlock

invigoration.detail: Every week, 3 random Warframes each receive 2 buffs (one primary, one secondary). Buff examples: +Ability Strength, +Health, +Shields, +Duration, +Parkour Velocity, +Efficiency. Primary buffs also apply to exalted weapons (e.g. Artemis Bow).
invigoration.title: What you get

invigoration.detail: Invigorations are weighted toward frames you rarely play — it's the game's way of bribing you to dust off your neglected frames. Buffs last until the next weekly reset.
invigoration.title: Weighted picks

invigoration.detail: Check the Helminth each week before planning your farming: a +Strength invigoration can turn a meme frame into a Steel Path farmer for the week.
invigoration.title: How to use it

secretions.desc: The rarest secretion. Made from high-value resources.
secretions.farm: Best sources: Morphics (Mars — Sargas Ruk assassination, survival), Cryotic (Excavation missions), Argon Crystals (Void — feed before the 24h decay), Nav Coordinates, Orokin Ciphers.
secretions.name: Bile
secretions.note: Budget carefully: subsuming Grendel and Gauss costs Bile, and total demand across all frames exceeds 1,800%.

secretions.desc: Plant and organic matter, liquidized. Easy to keep topped up once you fish Deimos.
secretions.farm: Best sources: Deimos fish parts and plants (Fass/Vome cycles), Cetus/Plains fish parts, Maprico, Pustulite.
secretions.name: Biotics
secretions.note: Fishing on Deimos doubles as Biotics farming — bring bait.

secretions.farm: Best sources: Rubedo (anywhere, stockpile it), Hexenon (Jupiter Disruption — also needed for crafting), Iradite (Plains of Eidolon mining), Lucent Teroglobe.
secretions.name: Calx
secretions.note: Hexenon is the bottleneck — farm Disruption on Jupiter when you need Calx.

secretions.desc: Common metals and alloys. The easiest secretion to fill.
secretions.farm: Best sources: Ferrite, Salvage, Alloy Plate (stockpiled from normal play), Oxium (Jupiter — kill Oxium Ospreys fast, e.g. Io defense).
secretions.name: Oxides
secretions.note: You'll rarely run dry; dump excess common metals here.

secretions.desc: Infested biomass. Moderate demand — subsuming and infusing eat a lot of it.
secretions.farm: Best sources: Nano Spores (Orokin Derelict/Deimos survival — bring Nekros), Plastids (Saturn/Phobos survival, e.g. Piscinas), Mutagen Samples (Derelict), Neurodes.
secretions.name: Pheromones
secretions.note: Total demand across all subsumes exceeds 1,500% — keep a healthy stock.

secretions.desc: Manufactured components and rare tech drops.
secretions.farm: Best sources: Circuits (stockpile), Orokin Cells (bosses — General Sargas Ruk, Lech Kril), Control Modules (Void), Neural Sensors (Jupiter).
secretions.name: Synthetics
secretions.note: Orokin Cells are the pain point; boss-rush them when low.

secretions.desc: A separate seventh appetite fed only with Sentient-derived resources. Used for specific Helminth functions.
secretions.farm: Sources: Intact/Exceptional/Flawless Sentient Cores (Sentient kills — Lua, Veil Proxima), Eidolon Shards (Teralyst/Gantulyst/Hydrolyst), Cetus Wisps (Plains at night), Anomaly Shards.
secretions.name: Sentient Appetite
secretions.note: Only fed with Sentient loot — keep cores stocked from Eidolon hunts.

subsume.detail: In your Orbiter, sit in the Helminth chair (Infested room, lower level) with the non-Prime Warframe equipped and choose Subsume. The frame is PERMANENTLY consumed — destroyed, not stored. Only feed duplicates or frames you're truly done with and can rebuild.
subsume.title: 1. Feed the frame

subsume.detail: Primes cannot be subsumed, ever. Neither can Excalibur Umbra. If you only own one copy of a frame, think twice — you'll have to farm or buy it again to play it.
subsume.title: 2. No Primes

subsume.detail: Subsuming takes 24 hours. When it finishes, that frame's signature subsumable ability is permanently unlocked in your Helminth and can be infused onto any other frame. Rushing with platinum is possible but rarely worth it.
subsume.title: 3. Wait 24 hours

subsume.detail: Each Warframe grants exactly ONE predetermined ability (e.g. Rhino always gives Roar). You choose which ability slot on the receiving frame it replaces. Only one subsumed/infused ability per config slot — the injected ability always occupies the same slot across all your configs for that frame.
subsume.title: 4. One ability per frame

subsume.detail: Feeding resources, subsuming frames and infusing abilities earns Metamorphosis XP. Ranks unlock: Rank 1 — subsuming + 3 subsume slots; Rank 2 — Rebuild Shields; Rank 3 — Perspicacity; Rank 4 — 10 subsume slots; Rank 5 — Energized Munitions; Rank 6 — Marked for Death; Rank 9 — Expedite Suffering; Rank 11 — Parasitic Armor; Rank 12 — Hideous Resistance; Rank 13 — Voracious Metastasis; Rank 14 — Sickening Pulse; Rank 15 — Golden Instinct.
subsume.title: 5. Rank up the Helminth

tierlist.bestOn: Literally any frame with a spare slot. Weapon platforms (Mesa, Mirage, Octavia) and one-shot builds.
tierlist.desc: War cry granting a large +damage buff to ALL damage (weapons and abilities) for a long duration. Scales with Ability Strength, recastable.
tierlist.name: Roar
tierlist.why: The universal damage multiplier. No setup, no downside, works on everything — the default answer to 'what do I put here?'.

tierlist.bestOn: Weapon DPS frames that can control lighting, or squishy frames that want the 75% damage reduction in darkness.
tierlist.desc: Toggle between two modes: in light, huge +weapon damage; in darkness, up to 75% damage reduction. Recast to swap.
tierlist.name: Eclipse
tierlist.why: Either the biggest weapon-damage buff in the game or near-immortality on demand. Light control (e.g. dark energy color) makes it consistent.

tierlist.bestOn: Status weapons, energy-hungry casters, frames with no native energy economy.
tierlist.desc: Adds Viral damage to all weapons and grants energy regeneration over time. Recastable.
tierlist.name: Nourish
tierlist.why: Free Viral weighting (the best status in the game) plus energy sustain in one slot. Fixes two build problems at once.

tierlist.bestOn: Melee face-tankers (Inaros, Grendel, Garuda), frames that want to stand in the fire.
tierlist.desc: Aura that slows enemies and steals life on every hit, healing you. Radius and strength scale well.
tierlist.name: Gloom
tierlist.why: Survivability and crowd control in one cast — the reason Sevagoth gets subsumed more than played.

tierlist.bestOn: High-strength frames with a dead slot (Volt, Saryn, Ember).
tierlist.desc: Slams an AoE nuke of Cold (or Heat, alternating) damage that scales brutally with Ability Strength and range.
tierlist.name: Thermal Sunder
tierlist.why: One of the hardest-hitting subsumable nukes. Clears rooms on Steel Path with enough strength investment.

tierlist.bestOn: Weapon platforms that want a neutral damage type; anti-Sentient loadouts.
tierlist.desc: Adds Void damage to weapons. Void is neutral against almost everything and resets Sentient adaptation.
tierlist.name: Xata's Whisper
tierlist.why: Free extra damage type with no downside, and the answer to Sentient damage adaptation.

tierlist.bestOn: Ability-spam frames, Steel Path comfort builds, frames with a weak 1st ability.
tierlist.desc: Manifests Heat motes that trigger whenever enemies take damage from your abilities or weapons — no line-of-sight needed, generous duration.
tierlist.name: Jade Stars
tierlist.why: After its buff, one of the trendiest subsumes: passive Heat DoTs stacking up on everything you touch, with great energy economy.

tierlist.bestOn: Wisp (buffs), Octavia, any frame with one big cast worth supercharging.
tierlist.desc: Helminth innate (Rank 0): +50% Ability Strength applied to your NEXT ability cast only. Not timed, doesn't scale — just works.
tierlist.name: Empower
tierlist.why: Sometimes better than Roar: no duration to maintain, works independent of your stats, and supercharges single casts like Wisp's buffs.

tierlist.bestOn: AoE frames that want a vacuum: Saryn, Mesa, Equinox, Xaku, Vauban.
tierlist.desc: Fires a tentacle that pulls enemies into a tight ball. Groups entire rooms for AoE follow-up.
tierlist.name: Larva
tierlist.why: Grouping is the most valuable CC in the game for clear speed — Larva is the best pull available to any frame.

tierlist.bestOn: Shield-gating frames, Hildryn-style tanks, any frame vs Corpus/Corrupted.
tierlist.desc: Steals shields and armor from enemies to restore your own shields. Full strips on cast with enough strength.
tierlist.name: Pillage
tierlist.why: Armor/shield strip plus instant shield restore — defense and offense in one button.

tierlist.bestOn: Grineer missions, armor-strip setups, frames without native strip.
tierlist.desc: Terrifies enemies (fear CC) and strips a large chunk of their armor.
tierlist.name: Terrify
tierlist.why: Cheap, spammable partial armor strip with CC attached. The budget answer to armored targets.

tierlist.bestOn: Shield frames, Harrow-style supports, frames that need breathing room.
tierlist.desc: Chains enemies in place and restores shields for each enemy hit.
tierlist.name: Condemn
tierlist.why: Hard CC plus shield sustain — excellent on shield-gating builds.

tierlist.bestOn: CC setups, defense missions, frames that need setup time.
tierlist.desc: Suspends enemies in the air, leaving them helpless and exposed.
tierlist.name: Ensnare
tierlist.why: Long-duration hard CC that also groups loosely — great for locking down points.

tierlist.bestOn: Endurance runs, energy-hungry frames, solo long missions.
tierlist.desc: Drops pickups that restore health, energy and ammo over time.
tierlist.name: Dispensary
tierlist.why: The only subsumable that solves ammo AND energy AND health. Mandatory for long endurance runs.

tierlist.bestOn: CC-hungry frames, defense, frames with follow-up AoE.
tierlist.desc: Blinds enemies and spawns sparks that jump between blinded targets for big damage.
tierlist.name: Breach Surge
tierlist.why: Blind is one of the strongest CC types, and the sparks turn it into real damage.

tierlist.bestOn: Frames with a truly dead slot and nothing better to put there.
tierlist.desc: Creates a wall of glass that reflects damage and CCs enemies that touch it. Weaker than the native version.
tierlist.name: Spectrorage
tierlist.why: Decent on paper, but the subsumed version loses the damage-scaling trick that makes Gara's own kit strong.

tierlist.bestOn: Support frames in premades; mostly a placeholder pick.
tierlist.desc: Heals a single target over time. Outclassed by virtually every other sustain option.
tierlist.name: Well of Life
tierlist.why: Single-target heal with no utility — Dispensary, Gloom and even Vazarin do the job better.

tierlist.desc: Mind-controls one enemy to fight for you. Unreliable AI, single target.
tierlist.name: Mind Control
tierlist.why: One unreliable ally is never worth a slot when real CC exists.

tierlist.desc: Deploys a stationary hologram decoy. Enemies mostly ignore it.
tierlist.name: Decoy
tierlist.why: Weak distraction with no damage or utility. There is always a better option.

unlock.detail: Finish the Heart of Deimos quest. This unlocks the Cambion Drift open world on Deimos and the Necralisk hub with the Entrati syndicate.
unlock.title: 1. Complete Heart of Deimos

unlock.detail: Run bounties on the Cambion Drift from Mother (or turn in family tokens) until you hit Rank 3: Associate with the Entrati.
unlock.title: 2. Reach Entrati Rank 3 (Associate)

unlock.detail: Buy the Helminth Segment blueprint from Son in the Necralisk for 15,000 Entrati standing. Requires Mastery Rank 8.
unlock.title: 3. Buy the Helminth Segment from Son

unlock.detail: Craft it in the Foundry (credits plus Cambion Drift materials, ~24h build), then install it in the Infested room of your Orbiter — the sealed door on the lower level, opened by Nidus or any Warframe carrying a mature Helminth cyst.
unlock.title: 4. Build and install the Segment
